facts.name: IBM
sentences: IBM's shares moved 5% or more on 15 of the last 252 sessions.
The last move at least this big in the same direction was on 11 November 2026, when the stock rose 1.5%.
The stock is down 16.6% this year, and at $247.13 it sits 24.9% below its 52-week closing high of $329.23 from 2 June 2026.
$1,000 invested in IBM five years ago would be worth $2,077 today.
